evidence.title: Nvidia senior manager linked to Supermicro scheme smuggling AI servers to China

summary: A senior manager at Nvidia has been linked to a scheme involving Supermicro that smuggled AI server hardware out of the United States for shipment to China, violating export controls. Authorities are investigating the alleged misconduct and its implications for technology transfer and national security.
title: Nvidia executive implicated in Supermicro scheme that illegally exported AI servers to China
